state.product: Accepted M0-D26 under 'Engagement acceptance record' says IndependenceEvaluation records rule-set version, all nonattest services considered, outcome, partner evaluation when conditional, management acknowledgement, approver and time. Impaired outcome blocks acceptance.
state.catalog: ClientIndependenceDecision invariant says immutable client independence preview that never grants production acceptance, but assigns it D26-06 and says that evaluation is refused unless it records the partner evaluation when conditional and management acknowledgement. Its materialization command has effectKind claim_professional_assertion_identity.
state.implementation: ClientIndependenceDecision stores one ClientIndependenceEvaluated with a frozen preview. IndependenceEvaluationView explicitly says it is a retained preview, never production acceptance or personal sign-off; it has rule version, service history, result, actor and time, but no partner evaluation or management acknowledgement. ServiceEngagementAcceptanceView has PartnerEvaluationReference and ManagementAcknowledgementId. MaterializeClientIndependencePreview materializes the preview; it does not claim a professional assertion. ClientIndependenceEvaluated carries TenantId and OperationId, also present in stream realm/resource and operation provenance. Revision and operation provenance are part of the native operation fact contract.
state.test: Tests check valid child materialization, invalid child provenance refusal without a fact, identity scope, valid replay, exact accepted binding replay, changed binding conflict, and refusal to append a competing preview.
